```{r libraries_helpers , results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggupset)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(patchwork)
library(openxlsx)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
#library(GSEABase)
cmd_args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
file_arg <- grep("^--file=", cmd_args, value = TRUE)
# if Rstudio set base dir to one level down from script path 
if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) && rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
    file_dir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)
    } else if (length(file_arg)) {
    file_dir <- dirname(sub("^--file=", "", file_arg))
    } else {
  file_dir <- getwd()
}
base_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(file_dir, "/../"))
res_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "/Results/")
script_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "/scripts/")
load(paste0(res_dir,"/ac_de.RData"))

source(file.path(script_dir, "/rnaseq_funcs.R"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = res_dir)
```

## Load in the data

```{r}

rna_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(res_dir,"DE_results/DE_genes.xlsx"), sheet = "hcec_ctrl")
prot_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(base_dir,"Proteomics/261006_limmaResult_IP_TMa_017_TMT_Run1_P_SN20PDnormAcaOnly.xlsx"), sheet = "limma result") %>% 
  filter(! str_detect(Description, "Homo sapiens")) %>% mutate(FDR_P = BUco_P_vs_BU_P_FDR, 
                                                               logFC_P = BUco_P_vs_BU_P_LOG2FC)
#prot_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("241018_limmaResult_IP_TMa_017_TMT_Run1_P_SN20.xlsx", sheet = "limma result") %>% filter(! str_detect(Description, "Homo sapiens"))
secr_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("Proteomics/261006_limmaResult_IP_TMa_017_TMT_Run1_S_SN20PDnormAcaOnly.xlsx", sheet = "limma result") %>% 
  filter(! str_detect(Description, "Homo sapiens")) %>% 
  mutate(FDR_S = BUco_S_vs_BU_S_FDR,
         logFC_S = BUco_S_vs_BU_S_LOG2FC)


```


```{r}
secr_data <- secr_data %>% mutate( regulation = sign(logFC_S) * as.numeric(FDR_S <= 0.05))
prot_data <- prot_data %>% mutate( regulation = sign(logFC_P) * as.numeric(FDR_P <= 0.05))
table(secr_data$regulation)
table(prot_data$regulation)
```


Get the uniprot ids of all proteins

```{r, eval=FALSE}
all_uniprots <- unique(c(prot_data$Accession, secr_data$Accession))
write(all_uniprots, file = file.path(base_dir, "References/all_uniprot_proteins.txt"))
length(all_uniprots)
```
Get the blast results for the matching of the uniprot and C3 proteins

```{r}
c3_up <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "RBH_BLAST/c3_vs_uniprot.tsv"), 
                   col_names = c("query", "subject", "pident",
                                 "length", "qlen", "slen", "evalue", "bitscore")) %>%
  mutate(qcov = length / qlen, scov = length / slen)
up_c3 <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "RBH_BLAST/uniprot_vs_c3.tsv"), 
                   col_names = c("query", "subject", "pident",
                                 "length", "qlen", "slen", "evalue", "bitscore")) %>%
  mutate(qcov = length / qlen, scov = length / slen)
```

Rank each list of results by bitscore, evalue and qcov, and only take top hit, inner join only idnetical pairs:

```{r}
best_c3_up <- c3_up %>% group_by(query) %>% filter(pident > 40 & qcov > 0.25) %>%
  arrange(desc(bitscore), evalue, desc(qcov), desc(scov)) %>%
  slice_head(n=1)  %>% dplyr::rename(uniprot = subject, c3 = query)
best_up_c3 <- up_c3 %>% group_by(query) %>% filter(pident > 40 & qcov > 0.25) %>% 
  arrange(desc(bitscore), evalue, desc(qcov), desc(scov)) %>%
  slice_head(n=1) %>% dplyr::rename(uniprot = query, c3 = subject)
# get reciprocal best hits
rbh_c3_up <- best_c3_up %>% inner_join(best_up_c3, by= c("uniprot", "c3"))
rbh_c3_up <- rbh_c3_up %>% mutate(c3 = str_replace(c3, "-T.*$", ""), 
                                  uniprot = str_replace(uniprot, "^.*\\|(.*)\\|.*$", "\\1"))
cat("RBH:", nrow(rbh_c3_up), "Percent of proteome:", round(100* nrow(rbh_c3_up)/length(all_uniprots)))
```

Map protein IDs to C3 gene IDs

```{r}
prot_map <- prot_ids %>% 
  left_join(rbh_c3_up %>% select(uniprot, c3), by = join_by(Accession == uniprot)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GeneID = c3)
```

```{r}
# add FUN id to prots and sec
# only use the rbh mapping, the ACA IDs do not work as well, as there are multiple entries for a lot of genes
prot_data_p <- prot_data %>% left_join(prot_map %>% select(Accession, GeneID)) %>% 
  mutate(GeneID = if_else(is.na(GeneID), Accession, GeneID)) %>% 
  left_join(rna_data %>% select(GeneID, Name)) %>%
  mutate(Name = if_else(is.na(Name), Gene, Name)) %>% 
  mutate(Name = if_else(is.na(Name), Accession, Name))
secr_data_p <- secr_data %>% left_join(prot_map %>% select(Accession, GeneID)) %>% 
  mutate(GeneID = if_else(is.na(GeneID), Accession, GeneID)) %>% 
  left_join(rna_data %>% select(GeneID, Name)) %>%
  mutate(Name = if_else(is.na(Name), Gene, Name)) %>% 
  mutate(Name = if_else(is.na(Name), Accession, Name))
```


```{r}
comb_data <- rna_data %>% select(GeneID, logFC, FDR, Name, Aca_neff_ID, Description) %>% 
  full_join(prot_data_p %>% select(GeneID, Gene, Accession, logFC_P, FDR_P, Description), by = "GeneID") %>% 
  full_join(secr_data_p %>% select(GeneID, Gene, logFC_S,FDR_S, Accession, Description), by = "GeneID")
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::rename)
comb_data_excel <- comb_data %>% mutate(
  Accession.x = if_else(is.na(Accession.x), 
                        Accession.y, Accession.x),
  Description = if_else(! is.na(Description.x),
                        Description.x,
                        if_else( ! is.na(Description.y), Description.y, Description),
                        Description),
  Gene.x = if_else(is.na(Gene.x), Gene.y, Gene.x)) %>% 
  rename(PDB_ID = Accession.x, GeneID_prot = Gene.x, 
         logFC_RNA = logFC, FDR_RNA = FDR, 
         ) %>% 
  select( -c(Accession.y, Description.x, Description.y, Gene.y)) %>%
  relocate(GeneID, PDB_ID, Name, Aca_neff_ID, GeneID_prot, Description )

# up down and incons for logFC
test_consist <- function(values){
  apply(values, 1, function(x) if(length(x[complete.cases(x)]) < 1) {NA} 
               else if(all(x[complete.cases(x)] > 0)){"up"}
               else if(all(x[complete.cases(x)] < 0)){"down"} 
               else{"incons"})
}
comb_data <- comb_data %>% 
  mutate(direction = test_consist(
    cbind(logFC, logFC_P, logFC_S))
    )
```

Write excel table

```{r}
comb_data_excel <- comb_data_excel %>% 
  mutate(dir_overall = test_consist(
    cbind(logFC_RNA, logFC_P, logFC_S)),
    dir_RNA_Prot = test_consist(
      cbind(logFC_RNA, logFC_P)),
    dir_RNA_Secr = test_consist(
      cbind(logFC_RNA, logFC_S)),
    dir_Prot_Secr = test_consist(
      cbind(logFC_P, logFC_S)),
  )

wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = "comp")
openxlsx::writeDataTable(wb, x = comb_data_excel, sheet = 1)
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file = file.path(base_dir,"comparison_RNAseq_proteome_secretome.xlsx"), 
                       overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Correlation plots

plot rna_seq lgfc against proteome

Get correlation coefficients:

```{r}
pearson_cor_prot_sig <- comb_data %>% filter(! (is.na(FDR) | is.na(FDR_P))) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05 | FDR_P <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarize(cor = cor(logFC, logFC_P,method = "pearson", use="complete.obs")) %>% 
  pull(cor)
spearman_cor_prot_sig <- comb_data %>% filter(! (is.na(FDR) | is.na(FDR_P))) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05| FDR_P <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarize(cor = cor(logFC, logFC_P,method = "spearman", use="complete.obs")) %>%
  pull(cor)
label_prot_sig <- paste0("Pearson r = ", round(pearson_cor_prot, 2), 
                "\nSpearman ρ = ", round(spearman_cor_prot, 2))

pearson_cor_sec_sig <- comb_data %>% filter(! (is.na(FDR) | is.na(FDR_S))) %>% 
  filter(FDR <= 0.05| FDR_S <= 0.05) %>%

  pull(cor)

  filter(FDR <= 0.05| FDR_S <= 0.05) %>%
```

## Upsetplots

```{r}
comb_data <- comb_data %>% mutate(RNAseq = ! is.na(FDR),
                                  Prot = ! is.na(FDR_P),
                                  Secr = ! is.na(FDR_S))
cat_cols <- c("RNAseq", "Prot", "Secr")
library(patchwork)
up1 <- upset(comb_data, cat_cols, name = "", width_ratio=0.2, 
            wrap = F, stripes = NA,
            set_sizes=( upset_set_size() + 
                          scale_y_reverse(breaks=c(0,5000, 10000))),
            themes = upset_modify_themes(
              list(
                "intersections_matrix" = theme(text = element_text(size=12), 
                                               panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                                               panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                               axis.title.x = element_blank()),
                "overall_sizes" = theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                                        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                                        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                        axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
                                        axis.title.x = element_blank()
                )
              ))
) 

uc1 <- upset(comb_data, cat_cols, name = "", width_ratio=0.2, 
      wrap = F, stripes = NA,
      set_sizes=(upset_set_size() + 
                    scale_y_reverse(breaks=c(0,5000, 10000))),
      base_annotations=list(
        'Intersection size'=intersection_size(
          mapping = aes(fill=direction)) + 
            scale_fill_manual(values=c(
            'down'='blue', 'incons'='lightgray',
            'up'='red'))
          ),
      themes = upset_modify_themes(
        list(
          "intersections_matrix" = theme(text = element_text(size=12), 
                                         panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                                         panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                         axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                         legend.position = "none"),
          "overall_sizes" = theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                                  panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                                  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                  axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
                                  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                  legend.position = "none"
                                  ),
          "Intersection size" = theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                                      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                      legend.position = "none")
          )
        ))

plot(uc1)
```

## Proteome and Secretome GO



```{r}
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
uniprot_annos <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Proteomics/proteome_idmapping_2026_10_21.tsv.gz"))
prots <- data.frame(accession = all_uniprots) %>% left_join(uniprot_annos, by=join_by(accession == From))
go_terms_up <- prots %>% filter(! is.na(`Gene Ontology IDs`)) %>% pull(`Gene Ontology IDs`) %>% str_split("; ") %>% unlist() %>% unique()
go_gmt_up <- lapply(go_terms_up, function(x) prots %>% filter( grepl(x,`Gene Ontology IDs`, fixed = TRUE)) %>% pull(accession) )
names(go_gmt_up) <- go_terms_up
go_terms_num_up <- sapply(go_gmt_up, length)
# only keep GO terms with at least 10 genes
go_terms_num_up <- go_terms_num_up[go_terms_num_up >= 10]
go_gmt_up <- go_gmt_up[names(go_terms_num_up)]
go_names_up <- unlist(lapply(names(go_terms_num_up), 
                          function (x) {
                            y <- AnnotationDbi::Term(x); 
                            if(is.na(y)) { y <- setNames(NA,x)} 
                            return(y)}))
go_ontology_up <- unlist(lapply(names(go_terms_num_up), AnnotationDbi::Ontology))
# do not need to remove ":" in GO terms
go_gmt_onts_up <- list()
for (onto in c("MF", "BP", "CC")){
  go_gmt_onts_up[[onto]] <- go_gmt_up[ names(go_ontology_up[go_ontology_up == onto])] 
  #names(go_gmt_onts[[onto]]) <- gsub(":","", names(go_gmt_onts[[onto]]))
}
#go_names[names(go_terms_num[go_terms_num < 5])]
```



```{r}
library(fgsea)
prot_stat <- setNames(-log10(prot_data$BUco_P_vs_BU_P_PVALUE) * sign(prot_data$logFC_P), prot_data$Accession)
secr_stat <- setNames(-log10(secr_data$BUco_S_vs_BU_S_PVALUE) * sign(secr_data$logFC_S), secr_data$Accession)
prot_go_fgsea <- list()
secr_go_fgsea <- list()
for (onto in c("MF", "BP", "CC")){
  prot_go_fgsea[[onto]] <- fgsea(pathways = lapply(go_gmt_onts_up[[onto]],
                                                  function(x) base::intersect(x, prot_data$Accession)),
                                stats = sort(prot_stat, decreasing = TRUE), minSize = 15, maxSize=500) %>% 
    mutate(go_name = go_names_up[pathway], go_ont = go_ontology_up[pathway]) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    relocate(all_of(c("go_name", "go_ont")), .after= pathway)
  secr_go_fgsea[[onto]] <- fgsea(pathways = lapply(go_gmt_onts_up[[onto]],
                                                  function(x) base::intersect(x, secr_data$Accession)),
                                stats = sort(secr_stat, decreasing = TRUE), minSize = 15, maxSize=500) %>% 
    mutate(go_name = go_names_up[pathway], go_ont = go_ontology_up[pathway]) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    relocate(all_of(c("go_name", "go_ont")), .after= pathway)
}
```

```{r}
         dpi=300, compression = 'lzw')
 
  
}
```

## KEGG annotations

```{r}
up_ko <- read_fwf(file.path(base_dir, "References/all_uniprot_kofamKoala_result.txt"), 
                  skip = 2) %>% 
  mutate(X7 = if_else(is.na(X8), X7, paste(X7,X8))) %>%
  select(-c(X1,X8))
colnames(up_ko) <- c("gene_name", "KO", "thrshld",
                     "score", "E-value",  "definition")
up_ko <- up_ko %>% mutate(Accession = str_extract(gene_name, 
                                                  "^.*\\|([A-Z0-9]+)\\|.*$", group = 1))
# KO identifiers -> KEGG pathways
ko_to_pathway <- KEGGREST::keggLink("pathway", "ko")  %>%
  enframe(name = "ko", value = "pathway") %>%
  filter(str_detect(pathway, "map")) %>%
  mutate(
    ko = str_remove(ko, "^ko:"),
    pathway = str_remove(pathway, "^path:")) %>%
  filter(ko %in% up_ko$KO)
# 4. Gather pathways for each uniprot id
#4a. Gather KO for each up
ko_pw_list <- ko_to_pathway %>% split(.$ko) %>% map(~ pull(.x, pathway))
up_kgs <- lapply(unique(unique(up_ko$Accession)), 
                 function(x) up_ko$KO[up_ko$Accession == x])
names(up_kgs) <- unique(unique(up_ko$Accession))
up_pathways <- lapply(up_kgs, function(x) ko_to_pathway$pathway[ko_to_pathway$ko %in% x])
up_pathways <- up_pathways[sapply(up_pathways, length) > 0]
up_allpathways <- unique(unlist(up_pathways))
up_pws_df <- lapply(up_pathways, paste, collapse=",") %>% unlist() 
up_pws_df <- data.frame(Accession = names(up_pws_df), pathways = up_pws_df)
up_gs <- list() 
up_allpathways <- up_allpathways[ ! grepl("^map0[75]", up_allpathways)]
up_allpathways <- up_allpathways[ ! grepl("^map0[69]", up_allpathways)]
up_allpathways <- up_allpathways[ ! grepl("^map042[67]", up_allpathways)]
up_allpathways <- up_allpathways[ ! grepl("^map04[96732]", up_allpathways)]
up_gs <- list()
for (pwy in up_allpathways){
  up_gs[[pwy]] <- up_pws_df %>% filter(str_detect(pathways, pwy)) %>% pull(Accession)
}
up_gs_len <- map(up_gs, length) %>% unlist()
up_gs <- up_gs[up_gs_len > 10]
up_gs_pws <- names(up_gs)
kegg_get_chunked <- function(ids, chunk_size = 50) {
  if (! all(str_detect(ids, "^map"))){
    ids <- paste0("map", ids)
    }
  chunks <- split(ids, ceiling(seq_along(ids) / chunk_size))
  map(chunks, KEGGREST::keggList) %>% list_c()
}
KEGG_names_up <- kegg_get_chunked(up_gs_pws)

```

```{r}
prot_kegg_fgsea <- fgsea(pathways = up_gs,
                                stats = sort(prot_stat, decreasing = TRUE), 
                         minSize = 15, maxSize=300) %>% 
    mutate(kegg_name = KEGG_names_up[pathway]) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    relocate(all_of(c("kegg_name")), .after= pathway)
secr_kegg_fgsea <- fgsea(pathways = up_gs,
                                stats = sort(secr_stat, decreasing = TRUE),
                                minSize = 15, maxSize=500) %>% 
    mutate(kegg_name = KEGG_names_up[pathway]) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    relocate(all_of(c("kegg_name")), .after= pathway)
```
